_note: Chapter 18 词汇卡内容。ipa = 音标; ex = 例句数组, 顺序与词表中该词出现的行序一致(多词性词给多个例句, 每个例句对应词性行); note = 用法提示/搭配。

ex.en: The academy offers short courses in photography.
ex.cn: 这家学院开设摄影短期课程。
ex.note: a military academy 军事学院；academy of art 艺术学院

ex.en: Every new customer soon became an acquaintance.
ex.cn: 每位新顾客很快都成了熟人。
ex.note: a casual acquaintance 泛泛之交；make the acquaintance of 结识

ex.en: The lab bought a more advanced machine last year.
ex.cn: 实验室去年添置了一台更先进的机器。
ex.note: advanced level 高级水平；advanced mathematics 高等数学

ex.en: Financial aid made it possible for her to stay in school.
ex.cn: 经济援助使她得以继续念书。
ex.note: with the aid of 在……的帮助下；first aid 急救

ex.en: A small fund aided the repair of the old chapel.
ex.cn: 一笔小资金资助了老礼拜堂的修缮。
ex.note: aid sb. in sth. 在某事上帮助某人；aid and abet 助纣为虐

ex.en: The club welcomes photographers of every level, from amateur to professional.
ex.cn: 俱乐部欢迎各水平的摄影者，从业余爱好者到专业选手。
ex.note: a complete amateur 完全的外行

ex.en: Their amateur show was sold out in two days.
ex.cn: 他们的业余演出两天就卖光了票。
ex.note: an amateur photographer 业余摄影爱好者

ex.en: The office was too small, so they rented another room upstairs.
ex.cn: 办公室太小了，他们又在楼上租了一间。
ex.note: one after another 一个接一个；another time 下一次

ex.en: She applied to the newspaper in her second year.
ex.cn: 她在大二时向这家报社投了申请。
ex.note: apply for a job 申请工作；apply sth. to sth. 把……应用于……

ex.en: His article on the old market appeared on page six.
ex.cn: 他写老市场的文章刊登在第六版。
ex.note: an article of clothing 一件衣服；articles of agreement 协议条款

ex.en: The bar had a warm, noisy atmosphere.
ex.cn: 那家酒吧气氛温暖而嘈杂。
ex.note: the atmosphere of a place 某处的气氛；in the atmosphere 弥漫在空气中

ex.en: The alarm clock failed to awake him.
ex.cn: 闹钟没能把他叫醒。
ex.note: awake sb. to sth. 使某人意识到某事

ex.en: He stayed awake until the file had been copied.
ex.cn: 他一直醒着，直到文件被复制完。
ex.note: be awake to 意识到；wide awake 完全清醒

ex.en: The barber downstairs has cut hair for forty years.
ex.cn: 楼下的理发师剪了四十年头发。
ex.note: barber shop 理发店

ex.en: The novel describes a beast that roams the empty streets.
ex.cn: 这部小说描写了一头在空荡街道上游荡的野兽。
ex.note: a beast of a …… 极……的；the beast 野兽

ex.en: The cat disappeared beneath the heavy blankets.
ex.cn: 猫钻进厚厚的毯子下面不见了。
ex.note: beneath the surface 在表面之下；beneath contempt 不屑一顾

ex.en: Do not blame him for the weather.
ex.cn: 别把天气怪到他头上。
ex.note: blame sb. for sth. 因某事责怪某人；blame sth. on sb. 把某事归咎于某人

ex.en: The driver was partly to blame for the crash.
ex.cn: 那场车祸司机要负一部分责任。
ex.note: be to blame for 对……负有责任；put the blame on 把责任推给

ex.en: He pulled on his old boots and went out into the rain.
ex.cn: 他穿上那双旧靴子，走进了雨里。
ex.note: a pair of boots 一双靴子；the boot 后备箱

ex.en: The farmer breeds sheep and sells them at the market.
ex.cn: 农场主养羊，在集市上卖掉。
ex.note: breed sth. into sth. 培育出；be bred from 由……繁殖而来

ex.en: That is a rare breed of cat.
ex.cn: 那是稀有品种的猫。
ex.note: a breed of dog 某种犬；a distinct breed 独特的类型

ex.en: Once a month they bury the old issues in the archive.
ex.cn: 他们每月把旧报纸埋进档案室。
ex.note: bury oneself in 埋头于；be buried in 被掩埋在

ex.en: The whole campus emptied out during the holidays.
ex.cn: 假期里整个校园都空了。
ex.note: on campus 在校园内；campus life 校园生活

ex.en: His cartoon of a sleepy cat won the cover contest.
ex.cn: 他画的那只打瞌睡的猫赢了封面竞赛。
ex.note: a political cartoon 政治漫画；cartoon character 卡通人物

ex.en: She was certain that the file had been saved.
ex.cn: 她确信文件已经存好了。
ex.note: be certain of 确信；certain people 某些人

ex.en: The chemical experiment in the lab went wrong twice.
ex.cn: 实验室那次化学实验出了两次问题。
ex.note: chemical reaction 化学反应；chemical industry 化学工业

ex.en: Farmers should not spray chemicals near a school.
ex.cn: 农民不该在学校附近喷洒化学品。
ex.note: agricultural chemicals 农用化学品；chemical waste 化学废料

ex.en: A rumour about the closure circulated all week.
ex.cn: 关于关门的传闻传了一整周。
ex.note: circulate among 在……中流传；circulate in the blood 随血液循环

ex.en: The clock on the wall runs four minutes fast.
ex.cn: 墙上的钟快了四分钟。
ex.note: around the clock 日夜不停地；clock in 打上班卡

ex.en: He writes a column on economics every Friday.
ex.cn: 他每周五写一栏经济专栏。
ex.note: a newspaper column 报纸专栏；a column of numbers 一列数字

ex.en: The old brass compass still points north.
ex.cn: 那支旧黄铜指南针依然指着北。
ex.note: a pair of compasses 一副圆规；beyond the compass of 超出……的范围

ex.en: Her review of the concert appeared on the front page.
ex.cn: 她那篇音乐会评论登在了头版。
ex.note: in concert 齐心协力；give a concert 举办音乐会

ex.en: The paper was delayed; consequently, the deadline had to be moved.
ex.cn: 印厂延误了，因此截稿期只好往后挪。
ex.note: consequently = therefore 因此；as a consequence 作为结果

ex.en: They signed a short contract with the printer.
ex.cn: 他们和印刷厂签了一份短期合同。
ex.note: sign a contract 签订合同；a contract of employment 劳动合同

ex.en: Metal contracts as it cools.
ex.cn: 金属冷却时会收缩。
ex.note: contract a disease 感染疾病；contract to do 签约做某事

ex.en: There is no correct answer to that question.
ex.cn: 那个问题没有正确答案。
ex.note: the correct answer 正确答案；correct in 正确表达

ex.en: He corrected three errors before the paper went to print.
ex.cn: 付印之前他改正了三处错误。
ex.note: correct oneself 自我纠正；a correction 订正

ex.en: A crack ran from the ceiling to the floor.
ex.cn: 一道裂缝从天花板一直延到地板。
ex.note: a crack in the wall 墙上的裂缝；a crack of dawn 破晓

ex.en: The old cup cracked in his hand.
ex.cn: 那只旧杯子在他手里裂开了。
ex.note: crack down on 严厉打击；crack a code 破解密码

ex.en: The heavy box crushed the eggs inside it.
ex.cn: 重箱子把里面的鸡蛋压碎了。
ex.note: crush a rebellion 镇压叛乱；be crushed by 被……压垮

ex.en: The basement walls were damp all winter.
ex.cn: 地下室的墙整个冬天都是潮的。
ex.note: damp air 潮湿的空气；dampen 减弱

ex.en: The staff decided on a mix of stories.
ex.cn: 编辑部决定把几种报道混在一起。
ex.note: decide on 决定选择；decide to do 决定做某事

ex.en: The delivery was late because the van broke down.
ex.cn: 送报晚了，因为面包车坏了。
ex.note: free delivery 免费送货；on delivery 交货时

ex.en: The dessert was simple but surprisingly good.
ex.cn: 那道甜点很简单，却出人意料地好吃。
ex.note: after dessert 甜点之后；a dessert menu 甜品单

ex.en: The difference between the two drafts was obvious.
ex.cn: 两个草稿之间的差别很明显。
ex.note: make a difference 有影响；the difference between A and B A与B的区别

ex.en: They got a discount for paying in advance.
ex.cn: 他们因为提前付款拿到了折扣。
ex.note: at a discount 以折扣价；give a discount 提供折扣

ex.en: The shop discounts all students with a student card.
ex.cn: 这家店对持学生证的学生一律打折。
ex.note: discount a possibility 排除某种可能

ex.en: He dived into the archive as soon as the staff meeting ended.
ex.cn: 编辑部会议一结束，他就扎进了档案室。
ex.note: dive into 投入；dive head first 一头扎进

ex.en: Our office is downstairs, in the old basement.
ex.cn: 我们的办公室在楼下，在旧图书馆的地下室里。
ex.note: go downstairs 下楼；a downstairs room 楼下的房间

ex.en: Their special issue was dull compared with ours.
ex.cn: 和我们的特刊比起来，他们的特刊很乏味。
ex.note: a dull afternoon 无聊的下午；dull light 暗淡的光

ex.en: She writes a column on economics for the paper.
ex.cn: 她为这份报纸写经济专栏。
ex.note: study economics 学习经济学；home economics 家政学

ex.en: The electronic newsletter comes out every Friday.
ex.cn: 电子通讯每周五出版。
ex.note: electronic mail 电子邮件；electronic devices 电子设备

ex.en: She enclosed the original negative in an envelope.
ex.cn: 她把原片装进一只信封随信寄去。
ex.note: enclose sth. in sth. 把……封在……里；enclosed 随信附上的

ex.en: Write your name on the envelope, please.
ex.cn: 请在信封上写上你的名字。
ex.note: an envelope of stamps 一套邮票；open an envelope 拆开信封

ex.en: The paper reports on the everyday life of the campus.
ex.cn: 这份报纸报道校园的日常生活。
ex.note: everyday life 日常生活；an everyday occurrence 天天发生的事

ex.en: The executive editor times every stage with his watch.
ex.cn: 执行主编用手表给每一个环节计时。
ex.note: chief executive 首席执行官；executive committee 执行委员会

ex.en: She was made executive editor of the paper.
ex.cn: 她被任命为这家报纸的执行主编。
ex.note: executive power 行政权力；executive staff 行政人员

ex.en: The paper is printed by an external contractor.
ex.cn: 这份报纸由一家外协公司代印。
ex.note: external factors 外部因素；external pressure 外部压力

ex.en: She is a fan of the paper and writes to us often.
ex.cn: 她是这份报纸的忠实读者，常给我们写信。
ex.note: a football fan 球迷；a fan of ……的爱好者

ex.en: She fanned the fire with an old newspaper.
ex.cn: 她用一张旧报纸扇火。
ex.note: fan out 扇形散开；fan the flames 火上浇油

ex.en: The best feature of the issue is the cover photograph.
ex.cn: 这一期最有特色的是封面照片。
ex.note: a feature article 特写文章；a key feature 主要特点

ex.en: The new shop features a wide range of books.
ex.cn: 这家新书店以品种繁多的图书为特色。
ex.note: feature a product 主打某产品；feature a singer 由某歌星主演

ex.en: This is the final issue she will sign.
ex.cn: 这是她签下的最后一期。
ex.note: the final decision 最终决定；final exam 期末考试

ex.en: Our team reached the final of the college competition.
ex.cn: 我们队打进了学院赛事的决赛。
ex.note: the final 决赛；finals 期末考试

ex.en: A flood of warnings filled the screen.
ex.cn: 屏幕上涌出一片警告信息。
ex.note: a flood of 大量涌来；in the flood 在洪水中

ex.en: Complaints flooded into the office after the notice appeared.
ex.cn: 通告贴出之后，抱怨涌进了办公室。
ex.note: flood in 大量涌入；be flooded with 充满

ex.en: Nobody could foresee the paper shortage.
ex.cn: 没有人能预料到会缺纸。
ex.note: foresee the future 预见未来

ex.en: The editor spoke about freedom and responsibility.
ex.cn: 主编谈到了自由与责任。
ex.note: freedom of speech 言论自由；in freedom 自由地

ex.en: A furnace rumbled behind the door all winter.
ex.cn: 门后那台火炉整个冬天都在低鸣。
ex.note: a blast furnace 高炉；furnace heat 熔炉热

ex.en: He had a genius for making people laugh.
ex.cn: 他有一种让人发笑的天赋。
ex.note: a genius for 有……的天赋；an artistic genius 艺术天才

ex.en: The masthead was printed in gold.
ex.cn: 报头是用金色印的。
ex.note: a gold medal 金牌；a gold leaf 金箔

ex.en: The cover had a gold background.
ex.cn: 封面上是一片金色的底色。
ex.note: gold leaf 金箔；golden age 黄金时代

ex.en: They crossed the wet grass of the quad.
ex.cn: 他们穿过宿舍区湿漉漉的草地。
ex.note: cut the grass 割草；grass green 草绿色

ex.en: He picked up the guitar and played a few chords.
ex.cn: 他拿起吉他弹了几个和弦。
ex.note: play the guitar 弹吉他；a guitar player 吉他手

ex.en: No real harm was done to the files.
ex.cn: 文件并没有受到真正的损害。
ex.note: do harm to 对……造成伤害；come to no harm 未受伤害

ex.en: The heels of his old boots were worn flat.
ex.cn: 他那双旧靴子的鞋跟已经磨平了。
ex.note: a high heel 高跟鞋；Achilles' heel 阿喀琉斯之踵

ex.en: They hired a van to take the negative to the printer.
ex.cn: 他们租了一辆面包车，把原片送去印刷厂。
ex.note: hire sb. to do 雇某人做；hire out 租出

ex.en: The hire of the van cost less than expected.
ex.cn: 租车的费用比预想的低。
ex.note: on hire 出租；for hire 供出租

ex.en: His wife has been in hospital for two months.
ex.cn: 他妻子已经住院两个月了。
ex.note: in hospital 住院；go into hospital 住院

ex.en: We bought ice-cream and fruit punch for the party.
ex.cn: 我们为晚会买了冰淇淋和水果宾治。
ex.note: an ice-cream parlour 冰淇淋店

ex.en: He understood the implication of her decision.
ex.cn: 他明白她这个决定背后的含义。
ex.note: by implication 含蓄地；have implications for 对……有影响

ex.en: Each individual page had to be measured by hand.
ex.cn: 每一个版面都得手工量出尺寸。
ex.note: individual effort 个人努力；individual rights 个人权利

ex.en: They reported the case without naming the individual.
ex.cn: 他们报道了这件事，却没有点名那个人。
ex.note: a private individual 私人；the rights of the individual 个人权利

ex.en: A student came in to inquire about the price of a haircut.
ex.cn: 一个学生进来问理发要多少钱。
ex.note: inquire about 询问；inquire into 调查

ex.en: The interaction between the words and the pictures was carefully planned.
ex.cn: 文字与图片之间的互动被精心设计过。
ex.note: interaction between ……之间的互动

ex.en: They isolated the infected files and copied them.
ex.cn: 他们把受感染的文件隔离出来并做了备份。
ex.note: isolate A from B 把A与B隔离

ex.en: The photograph was taken in July 1994.
ex.cn: 那张照片拍于一九九四年七月。
ex.note: the Fourth of July 美国独立日

ex.en: He arrived with a knife, a brush and a few pennies.
ex.cn: 他到来时口袋里只有一把刀、一把梳子和几枚便士。
ex.note: a knife and fork 刀叉；a pocket knife 折叠刀

ex.en: Everyone laughed at the joke in the cartoon.
ex.cn: 大家都被漫画里的笑话逗笑了。
ex.note: laugh at 嘲笑；burst out laughing 放声大笑

ex.en: The story had legal implications, but no real harm had been done.
ex.cn: 这件事牵涉到法律问题，但并没有造成真正的伤害。
ex.note: legal trouble 法律麻烦；legal advice 法律咨询

ex.en: The printer's limit was twelve pages.
ex.cn: 印刷厂的上限是十二页。
ex.note: the upper limit 上限；within limits 在限度之内

ex.en: The paper shortage may limit the issue to twelve pages.
ex.cn: 纸张短缺可能把这一期限制在十二页以内。
ex.note: limit sth. to 把……限制在……；be limited to 仅限于

ex.en: Their method was simple and perfectly logical.
ex.cn: 他们的方法简单而完全合乎逻辑。
ex.note: a logical conclusion 合乎逻辑的结论；logical thinking 逻辑思维

ex.en: "Yes, madam," he said, and everyone laughed.
ex.cn: “是，女士，”他说，大家都笑了。
ex.note: Madam 用于称呼陌生的女性，是正式说法

ex.en: His wrist moved in a slow, steady march as he worked.
ex.cn: 干活时，他的手腕以一种缓慢而稳定的节奏移动。
ex.note: in March 在三月；march in the rain 冒雨行进

ex.en: They measured each column to the millimetre.
ex.cn: 他们把每一栏都量到毫米。
ex.note: measure sth. with sth. 用……量；measure up to 符合标准

ex.en: The only real measure of the paper is how many people read it.
ex.cn: 衡量这份报纸的唯一标准，是有多少人读它。
ex.note: a safety measure 一项安全措施；take measures 采取措施

ex.en: The method was logical: they compared two time stamps.
ex.cn: 方法很合乎逻辑：他们比较了两个时间戳。
ex.note: a method of doing 做某事的方法；by this method 用这种方法

ex.en: The paper's mission is bigger than any one of us.
ex.cn: 报纸的使命比任何一个人都大。
ex.note: a mission to do 旨在做……；a space mission 太空任务

ex.en: The staff was mostly young, and the table was full of ideas.
ex.cn: 编辑部里多半是年轻人，桌上堆满了各种想法。
ex.note: mostly because 主要因为；mostly cloudy 多云

ex.en: A mysterious message appeared in every inbox.
ex.cn: 每个邮箱里都出现了一条神秘的消息。
ex.note: a mysterious stranger 神秘陌生人；remain mysterious 仍是个谜

ex.en: She negotiated a discount and a later deadline.
ex.cn: 她谈下了折扣和更晚的截稿期。
ex.note: negotiate with sb. 与某人谈判；negotiate a contract 商签合同

ex.en: The noise of the press came up through the floor.
ex.cn: 印刷机的声音从地板下面顶了上来。
ex.note: make a noise 发出响声；noise pollution 噪音污染

ex.en: The nursery next door used to be a bakery.
ex.cn: 隔壁那所托儿所从前是家面包房。
ex.note: a nursery school 幼儿园；a plant nursery 苗圃

ex.en: The editor's office is in the basement of the old library.
ex.cn: 编辑室在老图书馆的地下室。
ex.note: keep an office 开设办事处；office hours 办公时间

ex.en: The crossword page was optional, and nobody complained.
ex.cn: 填字游戏版是可选的，没人抱怨。
ex.note: optional courses 选修课；an optional extra 可选附加项

ex.en: From the outset, she wanted the issue to feel like a gift.
ex.cn: 从一开始，她就希望这一期读起来像一份礼物。
ex.note: from the outset 从一开始；at the outset 起初

ex.en: A painting of the old campus hung above his desk.
ex.cn: 他桌上方挂着一幅旧校园的画。
ex.note: a watercolour painting 水彩画；oil painting 油画

ex.en: A passenger on the bus read the story and missed her stop.
ex.cn: 公交车上一位乘客读着这篇报道，坐过了站。
ex.note: bus passengers 公交乘客；a fellow passenger 同车乘客

ex.en: He arrived with a knife, a brush and a few pennies.
ex.cn: 他来时口袋里只有一把刀、一把梳子和几枚便士。
ex.note: penny saved is a penny earned 省下一分是一分

ex.en: The strange phenomenon on the network was solved in two days.
ex.cn: 网络上的那个怪现象两天就解决了。
ex.note: a natural phenomenon 自然现象；a rare phenomenon 罕见现象

ex.en: It is a pity that the shop will close.
ex.cn: 这店要关门，实在可惜。
ex.note: What a pity! 真可惜！；with pity 怀着同情

ex.en: He never showed pity for the old barber, who asked for no sympathy.
ex.cn: 他从不怜悯那位老理发师——老人也不要同情。
ex.note: pity sb. 同情某人；feel pity for 为……感到难过

ex.en: He swept the hair beside the red and white pole.
ex.cn: 他在红白相间的转灯柱旁扫着碎发。
ex.note: a barber's pole 理发店转灯柱；the North Pole 北极

ex.en: A camera was the only possession of real value that Mark owned.
ex.cn: 相机是马克唯一值钱的家当。
ex.note: in possession of 拥有；take possession of 占有

ex.en: The design editor was pregnant and worked from home.
ex.cn: 美术编辑怀孕了，在家办公。
ex.note: be pregnant with 怀有；pregnant women 孕妇

ex.en: Writing her thesis is now her top priority.
ex.cn: 写毕业论文现在是她最要紧的事。
ex.note: a top priority 头等大事；give priority to 优先考虑

ex.en: The editor pronounced the issue ready at last.
ex.cn: 主编最后宣布这一期完工。
ex.note: pronounce a word 发音；pronounce judgment 宣判

ex.en: The machine punches the holes in the paper.
ex.cn: 这台机器在纸上打孔。
ex.note: punch a hole in 在……上打洞；punch sb. in the face 拳打某人脸

ex.en: He took a punch at the door and went in.
ex.cn: 他朝门捶了一拳，走了进去。
ex.note: take a punch at 打一下；a punch card 穿孔卡

ex.en: The final week was a race against the clock.
ex.cn: 最后一周是一场与时间的赛跑。
ex.note: a race against time 与时间赛跑；the human race 人类

ex.en: He raced down the stairs to meet the printer.
ex.cn: 他飞奔下楼去赶印刷厂的人。
ex.note: race against 与……赛跑；race to do 抢先做

ex.en: She readily agreed to take on the new writer.
ex.cn: 她一口答应收下这个新来的写手。
ex.note: readily available 随时可得的；readily admit 坦然承认

ex.en: A message with a red envelope was circulating in her inbox.
ex.cn: 一封带着红信封的消息在她的邮箱里流传。
ex.note: red flag 危险信号；turn red 脸红

ex.en: For once nobody mentioned the deadline, and everyone could relax.
ex.cn: 这一回谁也没提截稿，所有人都放松了下来。
ex.note: relax the rules 放宽规定；relax into 放松地进入

ex.en: One photograph would not reproduce clearly in print.
ex.cn: 有一张照片印出来不清楚。
ex.note: reproduce a result 复现结果；reproduce conditions 复制条件

ex.en: The shortage restricted the issue to twelve pages.
ex.cn: 纸张短缺把这一期限制在十二页以内。
ex.note: restrict sth. to 把……限制在……；be restricted from 受……限制

ex.en: Their rival, a student magazine, printed its special first.
ex.cn: 他们的对手是一本学生杂志，先出了特刊。
ex.note: beat a rival 击败对手；a rival firm 竞争对手公司

ex.en: No other paper on campus can rival it.
ex.cn: 校园里没有哪份报纸能与之匹敌。
ex.note: rival sb. for sth. 与某人争夺……

ex.en: A crack ran from the ceiling to the rug.
ex.cn: 一道裂缝从天花板一直延到地毯上。
ex.note: a prayer rug 礼拜毯；pull the rug from under sb. 抽掉某人脚下的毯子

ex.en: The result was satisfactory, though nobody was celebrating.
ex.cn: 结果还算令人满意，不过没人庆祝。
ex.note: satisfactory to 对……满意；to my satisfaction 令我满意的是

ex.en: His mother scolded him for staying out late.
ex.cn: 他妈妈责骂他回来得太晚。
ex.note: scold sb. for sth. 因某事责骂某人

ex.en: The editor chose a wide selection of stories for the issue.
ex.cn: 主编为这一期挑了一组各色文章。
ex.note: a selection of 一批精选；make a selection 挑选

ex.en: She sewed the pages together by hand.
ex.cn: 她亲手把那些版面缝在一起。
ex.note: sew sth. up 缝好；sew by hand 手工缝制

ex.en: Nobody foresaw the paper shortage.
ex.cn: 没有人预料到会缺纸。
ex.note: a shortage of 短缺；staff shortage 人手不足

ex.en: The recipe was simple enough for any student to follow.
ex.cn: 这个食谱简单得任何学生都照着做得到。
ex.note: a simple answer 简单的答案；simple and plain 简单明了

ex.en: She told them to go home and sleep.
ex.cn: 她让他们回家睡觉。
ex.note: go to sleep 入睡；a good night's sleep 一夜好眠

ex.en: He walked home with one sock wet from the snow.
ex.cn: 他走回家，一只袜子被雪水浸湿了。
ex.note: a pair of socks 一双袜子；sock it to me 别抱怨了

ex.en: A sound like the press came up through the floor.
ex.cn: 一种像印刷机的声音从地板下面传上来。
ex.note: the sound of ……的声音；at the sound of 一听到……

ex.en: It sounds like a good plan, but check the numbers.
ex.cn: 这听起来是个好计划，不过还是核一下数字。
ex.note: sound like 听起来像；sound asleep 熟睡

ex.en: He gave a sound reason for the delay.
ex.cn: 他给出了一个站得住脚的延迟理由。
ex.note: a sound argument 合理论据；sound sleep 酣睡

ex.en: The common room was a public sphere where anyone could comment.
ex.cn: 公共休息室是一个任何人都可以发表评论的公共空间。
ex.note: the political sphere 政治领域；in the sphere of 在……范围内

ex.en: The office keeps a stamp for the delivery date.
ex.cn: 办公室有一枚用来盖交付日期的印章。
ex.note: a postage stamp 邮票；stamp duty 印花税

ex.en: Make sure the date is stamped on every box.
ex.cn: 每一箱都要盖上日期。
ex.note: stamp sth. with sth. 在……上盖上……；stamp one's feet 跺脚

ex.en: The criticism may sting, but it is fair.
ex.cn: 那份批评也许会刺痛人，但它是公允的。
ex.note: a sting of conscience 内疚；sting sb. 刺痛某人

ex.en: The first snow made a striking photograph.
ex.cn: 第一场雪拍成了一张极引人注目的照片。
ex.note: a striking contrast 鲜明的对比；strike sb. 给某人留下深刻印象

ex.en: The budget was sufficient, though not generous.
ex.cn: 预算够用，虽然谈不上宽裕。
ex.note: sufficient for 足够……；have sufficient 拥有足够的

ex.en: She was sure the file had been saved.
ex.cn: 她确信文件已经存好了。
ex.note: be sure of 确信；make sure 确保

ex.en: "Are you coming to the meeting?" "Sure, I will."
ex.cn: “你来开会吗？”“当然来。”
ex.note: sure enough 果然；as sure as 确定无疑

ex.en: The first symptom of the virus was a missing file.
ex.cn: 那场病毒最初的征兆是一个丢失的文件。
ex.note: a symptom of 症状；show symptoms 出现症状

ex.en: The issue included a page about modern technology.
ex.cn: 这一期有一个版面讲现代科技。
ex.note: advanced technology 高新技术；information technology 信息技术

ex.en: She thanked everyone at the party by name.
ex.cn: 她在晚会上把每个人的名字都道了一遍谢。
ex.note: thank sb. for 为……感谢某人；thank you 谢谢

ex.en: She expressed her thanks in a short note.
ex.cn: 她在一张便条里表达了谢意。
ex.note: give thanks 表示感谢；thanks to 多亏

ex.en: He had cut hair in the same shop for thirty years.
ex.cn: 他在同一家店里剪了三十年头发。
ex.note: thirty years 三十年

ex.en: For the first time, the whole staff worked through the night.
ex.cn: 第一次，全体编辑部成员熬了一个通宵。
ex.note: in time 及时；the first time 第一次

ex.en: The editor timed every stage of the work with her watch.
ex.cn: 主编用手表给每一个工作环节计时。
ex.note: time sb. / sth. 为……计时；time and again 屡次三番

ex.en: He took a torch and went down to the basement.
ex.cn: 他拿起一支手电筒，下了地下室。
ex.note: a torch 火炬；torchlight 手电筒的光

ex.en: The whole thing was a trap, and everyone fell into it.
ex.cn: 整件事就是个圈套，所有人都掉进去了。
ex.note: a trap for 针对……的陷阱；set a trap 设下陷阱

ex.en: The student had set a trap to see how the paper would react.
ex.cn: 那个学生设了个圈套，只为看看这家报纸会作何反应。
ex.note: trap sb. into doing 诱使某人做……

ex.en: In the basement it was a simple habit of checking, asking and telling the truth.
ex.cn: 在地下室里，那不过是核查、提问、说真话这样一套简单的习惯。
ex.note: the truth is 事实是；tell the truth 说真话

ex.en: Underneath the stairs there was a low room full of old papers.
ex.cn: 楼梯底下有一间堆满旧报纸的低矮屋子。
ex.note: underneath 在……下面；underneath it all 归根结底

ex.en: The smoke moved slowly upward through the cracked window.
ex.cn: 烟从裂开的窗户缓缓向上升去。
ex.note: an upward movement 向上运动；upward and downward 上上下下

ex.en: Various ideas filled the long table that evening.
ex.cn: 那天晚上，长桌上堆满了各种各样的想法。
ex.note: various reasons 各方面的原因；on various occasions 多次

ex.en: The office computer caught the virus too.
ex.cn: 编辑部的电脑也中了病毒。
ex.note: a computer virus 计算机病毒；virus infection 病毒感染

ex.en: He came to the city after the war with only a few coins.
ex.cn: 战后他来到这座城里，身上只有几枚硬币。
ex.note: before/after the war 战前/战后；at war 处于战争状态

ex.en: They worked through the whole weekend.
ex.cn: 他们整个周末都在干活。
ex.note: at the weekend 在周末；weekend papers 周末版

ex.en: Who signed the contract on that Friday?
ex.cn: 那个星期五是谁签的合同？
ex.note: who knows 谁知道；ask who 问是谁

ex.en: Within a week, the shop had more customers than in a whole year.
ex.cn: 不到一周，这家店的顾客就比一整年还多。
ex.note: within hours 数小时内；within reach 触手可及

ex.en: His wrist moved in a slow, steady rhythm as he worked.
ex.cn: 干活时，他的手腕以一种缓慢而稳定的节奏移动着。
ex.note: a broken wrist 手腕骨折；wrist watch 手表
